vectors.name: admin/interface
vectors.description: The canonical interface document of sparrow.hub.admin v1 (hub-admin section 5): types 64-83, enum sigils 64-72 (kind 0), service 0 Admin with methods 0-11. Method flags: 0x1 (idempotent) on get, validate, confirm, deleteSecret, listSecrets, putFacet, deleteFacet and listFacets; 0x10 on watch, whose output is [3, Event]; no other flags. Optional fields have flag 0x1 and type [2, T]. The interface carries no annotations, every errors list is empty (all errors the methods name are core status codes), and its version is "1.0.0".

vectors.name: admin/facet
vectors.description: A hub's sparrow.hub.admin facet, version 1.0.0, under facet ID 20 (the hub's choice). It implements admin/interface and adds the hint annotation "sparrow.level": "manage" to every method (hub-admin section 1); annotations are not part of wire shapes, so it conforms.

vectors.name: admin/stored-facet-key
vectors.description: The stored-facet key putFacet returns for facet/acme-charts (hub-admin 2.1): 0x01 || SHA-256 of the canonical facet with its ID set to 0 and its name kept. The facet hash of the same facet blanks the name as well (core 6.6), so the two differ; a hub lists facets by stored-facet key in NodeConfig.facets and by facet hash in schemas.

vectors.name: admin/value/config
vectors.description: A Config (type 64) with five nodes: acme.charts spawned with an environment holding a literal and a secret, and listing its stored facet by stored-facet key; acme.notes dialed at an https URL with a 32-byte pin and the credential secret the hub presents; acme.sensor dialing in; hub-b, a peer hub dialing in; acme.old, disabled. defaults maps the Renderer interface hash to acme.charts, and extensions carries the reference server's ref.policy as an embedded CBOR document. Absent optional fields are null and trailing nulls are omitted.
